notes.title: Version 1.2 Release
notes.content: [list][*][p]Even when Japanese is selected in the language settings, Simplified Chinese and Korean can now also be chosen from Config.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Auto mode and Skip mode would stop during certain scenes.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected typos, misspellings, and furigana.[/p][/*][/list]
